In this post, we will explore the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-16|The Real]] behind automated ebook delivery, giving you the insights needed to implement this system effectively.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a process that removes the barriers typically imposed by conventional payment platforms. In regions where payment options are restricted, this infrastructure enables creators to sell their digital products directly to their audience. By utilizing blockchain technology and decentralized payment systems, you can ensure that transactions are secure, fast, and cost-effective. This matters because it allows creators to focus on their craft without being held back by financial institutions that do not serve their needs. When you control the entire sales process, you own your data, your revenue, and ultimately, your success.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

This infrastructure is built on a combination of technologies that work seamlessly together. It starts with a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provides a free platform for your digital store. The backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which processes orders and triggers automated delivery of products. For payment processing, you utilize NOWPayments, which allows for crypto transactions without the need for KYC or a buyer account. The entire process is streamlined, ensuring that once a payment is confirmed on-chain, your customers receive their ebooks instantly. This architecture empowers you to maintain sovereignty over your commerce without dependency on traditional platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in countries like Kenya, where conventional payment methods are either unavailable or severely limited. Whether you create ebooks, online courses, or other digital products, this architecture enables you to reach your audience and generate revenue without external interference. By adopting this system, you can eliminate the frustrations associated with traditional payment processors. It's about empowering creators to thrive in an ecosystem that respects their autonomy and creativity. If you are ready to take charge of your digital commerce, this infrastructure is built for you.
Take control of your online sales today.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The complete architecture consists of several critical components: a hosting solution (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets), file delivery (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2), and payment processing (NOWPayments). Each component plays a vital role in ensuring that your system operates smoothly. For instance, when a customer makes a purchase, the payment processing via NOWPayments triggers a webhook that initiates the delivery of their digital product. This integration allows for a seamless experience, ensuring that all components work together efficiently without any reliance on traditional payment infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this system, start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all necessary blueprints and templates. Begin by setting up your chosen hosting solution, then configure the backend logic to manage orders. Next, set up your payment processing with NOWPayments, ensuring that you choose the recommended networks for low fees. Once configured, load your digital products into the system and run tests to ensure everything is functioning correctly. Finally, launch your store and promote it to your audience. With this infrastructure, you can begin selling your digital products without the limitations imposed by traditional payment platforms.

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a system designed for digital creators who cannot rely on payment processors like Stripe or PayPal. By utilizing a combination of free hosting solutions, backend logic, and crypto payment processing, creators can seamlessly deliver their digital products. This infrastructure not only addresses the technical challenges but also empowers creators to take charge of their online sales and data ownership.
Experience seamless automated delivery of your digital products.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit from COREMERCH. 2. Choose your hosting solution: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Configure NOWPayments for crypto transactions. 5. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Prepare your digital products for delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Test the entire process to ensure smooth functionality. 8. Launch your store and promote it to your audience.
